strings.name: Drake
strings.summary: Born Aubrey Drake Graham, Drake moved from Canada’s Degrassi television series into music, combining melodic rap and R&B in a style influential in the streaming era. Take Care, Views and Scorpion expanded his international audience. His feud with Kendrick Lamar led to a defamation suit against his record company; after dismissal, an appeal remained pending. In 2026 he released Iceman and two other albums simultaneously.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Combining rap and melodic singing, his albums and collaborations spread Canadian music and streaming-era popular styles.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education and beginnings
strings.facts.f2.value: Entered television as a teenager, interrupted high school, then completed secondary education in 2012.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Rap and melodic singing
strings.highlights.h1.text: Combined R&B emotional expression with hip-hop, influencing Canadian music and international popular styles.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Albums and cross-platform collaborations
strings.highlights.h2.text: Take Care won a rap-album Grammy, while albums and collaborations expanded streaming-era audiences.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Released three albums together
strings.timeline.t1.text: Released Iceman, Habibti and Maid of Honour, continuing different rap and pop approaches.
strings.timeline.t2.title: UMG suit dismissed and appealed
strings.timeline.t2.text: His defamation suit over distribution of Not Like Us was dismissed; the appeal remained pending in 2026.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Released For All the Dogs
strings.timeline.t3.text: Added a new solo album alongside ongoing collaborations and recording projects.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Released double album Scorpion
strings.timeline.t4.text: Organized the record into rap and R&B sections, including God’s Plan.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Released Views
strings.timeline.t5.text: Combined Toronto experiences and Caribbean influences, expanding international streaming audiences.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Won first Grammy
strings.timeline.t6.text: His 2011 album Take Care won Best Rap Album.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Released official debut album
strings.timeline.t7.text: Thank Me Later followed an audience already established through mixtapes.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Expanded reach with So Far Gone
strings.timeline.t8.text: The mixtape and its songs broadened his audience before he signed with Young Money.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Acted in Degrassi
strings.timeline.t9.text: Played Jimmy Brooks in the Canadian teen television series, beginning his professional acting career.
